name: Xingqiu
title: Juvenile Galant
description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

skills.name: Guhua Style
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
skills.description:
Xingqiu performs twin strikes with his sword, dealing Hydro DMG. At the same time, this ability creates the maximum number of Rain Swords, which will orbit your active character.
The Rain Swords have the following properties:
·When a character takes DMG, the Rain Sword will shatter, reducing the amount of DMG taken.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption.

20% of Xingqiu's Hydro DMG Bonus will be converted to additional DMG Reduction for the Rain Swords.

The maximum amount of additional DMG Reduction that can be gained this way is 24%.
The initial maximum number of Rain Swords is 3.
Using this ability applies the Wet status onto the character.
skills.info: "Easier to slay a rain dragon than to sever the rain."

skills.name: Guhua Sword: Raincutter
skills.description:
Initiate Rainbow Bladework and fight using an illusory sword rain, while creating the maximum number of Rain Swords.

Rainbow Bladework
·Your active character's Normal Attacks will trigger consecutive sword rain attacks, dealing Hydro DMG.
·Rain Swords will remain at the maximum number throughout the ability's duration.
skills.info: The "Way of the Rain Cutter" is one of the esoteric secret techniques of the Guhua Sect.

passives.name: Hydropathic
passives.description: When a Rain Sword is shattered or when its duration expires, it regenerates the current character's HP based on 6% of Xingqiu's Max HP.

passives.name: Blades Amidst Raindrops
passives.description: Xingqiu gains a 20% Hydro DMG Bonus.

passives.name: Flash of Genius
passives.description: When Xingqiu crafts Character Talent Materials, he has a 25% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

constellations.name: The Scent Remained
constellations.description: Increases the maximum number of Rain Swords by 1.

constellations.name: Rainbow Upon the Azure Sky
constellations.description:
Extends the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3s.
Decreases the Hydro RES of opponents hit by sword rain attacks by 15% for 4s.

constellations.name: Weaver of Verses
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Evilsoother
constellations.description: Throughout the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter, the DMG dealt by Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen is increased by 50%.

constellations.name: Embrace of Rain
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Hence, Call Them My Own Verses
constellations.description: Activating 2 of Guhua Sword: Raincutter's sword rain attacks greatly enhances the third sword rain attack. On hit, the third sword rain attack also regenerates 3 Energy for Xingqiu.

outfits.name: Bamboo Rain
outfits.description: Formal wear prepared by the Feiyun Commerce Guild for Xingqiu. The bamboo prints are refined and the cut is most flattering, but Xingqiu's favorite aspect of the outfit is its inner pockets, into which a thinner novel might be stuffed.

outfits.name: Azure Silk
outfits.description: Xingqiu's outfit. Fine robes woven from the high-quality silk sold by the Feiyun Commerce Guild.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Xingqiu at your service, my liege! I humbly trust that even one such as I, a mere bookworm, may yet prove to be of some utility under your wise leadership. Nice, I don't often get a chance to speak with such formality. It felt pretty good!

voices.title: Chat: Night of Solitude
voices.text: 'Twas on a deserted moonlit night that the hero approached the vile dragon's limpid lair...

voices.title: Chat: Literature
voices.text: I never embark on a journey without a good book to accompany me.

voices.title: Chat: Taking a Break
voices.text: Now this is what I call, "a moment of solitude."

voices.title: Chat: Reading
voices.text: Oh my goodness... Oh my gosh... Wow— Huh? "All will be revealed in the next volume"? Aw, drat...

voices.title: Chat: New Books
voices.text: If my calculations are correct, Wanwen Bookhouse is due to receive a batch of new releases today. Might we add a small detour to our adventure?

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: My family makes ornate umbrellas that block neither rain nor shine. Their sole purpose is for decoration upon a wall.

voices.title: After the Rain
voices.text: Good, the rain has stopped. Any longer and my books would have gotten wet.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: Only when it snows like this would I prefer to be at home than in a book store. For there is a well-stocked fireplace at home, while there is no fire allowed in book stores.

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: Great weather for practicing martial arts, but perfect weather for reading. Hey, what's that ridiculous look for? You look as if you're trying to decipher some strange text written on my forehead.

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Morning! The morn hours are precious. Spend them on that which matters to you.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I am uninclined to eat a heavy meal this luncheon, but instead indulge in some baked treats. As long as I eat in the study, my father and brother never have to know! Oh, you want to join me? Well... As long as you don't get crumbs on the books, I suppose it's fine.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: What say you we snatch a few fireflies and read in the light they give? Hehe... Hey, I'm joking. Seriously, don't, it's bad for your eyesight.

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: You will find me in the same place as ever tomorrow. So I'll see you then. Unless you manage to get lost on the way.

voices.title: About Xingqiu
voices.text: I always have to put on an act around other people, because they see me only as the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild. It's a relief that I can just be myself around you. I think it's because you don't see me in the same way.

voices.title: About Us: Reading Buddies
voices.text: I would say we are book buddies. Huh? Combat? Guhua Clan? Comrades in arms? ...What on earth are you talking about? I told you that's our little secret!

voices.title: About Us: Swornship
voices.text: We should become sworn siblings, let's go to the altar at Jueyun Karst. Nope, no ifs, no buts, you know too much about me! You know the real me, the one I normally have to hide. I simply can't let you go until you promise me you will go through with it!

voices.title: About the Vision: Ancient Books
voices.text: There aren't many records on matters concerning Visions, but I do have a passage dedicated to the topic in my collection of ancient texts. I can lend it to you if you want.

voices.title: About the Vision: Realization
voices.text: I've come to an epiphany based on some things I've been reading — ultimately, the arts of both the polearm and the sword are just the art of hand-eye coordination. Ugh, it's a little difficult to explain... If you want to know more, come with me to Wangshan Hall. But first, you have to promise me you won't laugh.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: Must-see places in Liyue? That's a tough question. Hmm... The place I would miss the most if it disappeared would be the Wanwen Bookhouse, first and foremost. The Guhua Sect would be in the top ten, too.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: I used to like rabbits, but I'm more a fan of stags now. To me, the saying "May my final stand be a monument to chivalry" is about abandoning worldly possessions and reaching enlightenment. But the stag's final resting place represents the hope for life anew. Oh, how I'd love to see it again.

voices.title: About Beidou
voices.text: I have great respect for Lady Beidou. I just wish she wouldn't call me "kid" and ruffle my hair each time she sees me.

voices.title: About Ningguang
voices.text: In her capacity as the Tianquan, I am obliged to respect her. Otherwise, it could create issues for my father and brother. On a personal level? Let me think... I think I will go with "no comment." I shan't speak ill of others.

voices.title: About Chongyun
voices.text: Ah, dear Chongyun. Though he understands me quite well, one has to exercise caution when teaming up with him to go on a quest. He is making good progress in the martial arts, but I would say he hasn't quite internalized the chivalric code yet... He needs more practice. Especially at eating spicy food...

voices.title: About Yun Jin
voices.text: When Yun Jin drinks a beverage she is fond of, she will be inspired to write a new play. So, I keep a jar of tea leaves under my bed at all times, ready to deliver to her on the day that her inspiration dries up. This way, I shall never run out of heroic tales to listen to!

voices.title: About Hu Tao
voices.text: Ah yes, the young lady who is now the Master of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. If you're asking what I think about her as a person... Well, there are all sorts of rumors about the way she works. But I think if you really want to understand someone, you need to find out what they are really after.

voices.title: About Qiqi
voices.text: I've always thought there is more to Qiqi than meets the eye. But it's impossible to have a conversation with her when Baizhu's around. Hmm... We could wait till Baizhu makes a home call to one of his other patients and corner her...

voices.title: About Xiangling
voices.text: When you first spot Xiangling out and about, the first thing you should do is check the look on her face. Especially when she's just coming back from collecting new ingredients — the more excited she looks, the more dangerous it is to approach. Because if she sees you, she'll force you to taste-test her latest concoction... I usually get Chongyun to handle these situations, hehe...

voices.title: About Xinyan
voices.text: Where does Xinyan perform? Anywhere from Chihu Rock to Yujing Terrace — no spot is untouched by her disruptive presence... A quiet day when I can curl up with a good book is a rare treasure indeed.

voices.title: About Albedo
voices.text: I've thought of all the illustrations I want for each major event in the next three volumes! I should write my thoughts down before I forget them, and send them to Mr. Kreideprinz...

voices.title: About Zhongli
voices.text: My father and brother entertained that gentleman as a guest once. From the way they were acting, he must be a very high-profile figure indeed. I also heard that he directs funerals for the adepti, so he must surely have great depth to his character. We should do some digging and see what we can find out about him!

voices.title: About Shenhe
voices.text: I find that Miss Shenhe seems to look at me somewhat fiercely, so I daren't approach her lightly. Bizarre, did I inadvertently upset her? Or maybe... upset someone close to her?

voices.title: About Yelan
voices.text: Have you heard the expression "same person, different face"? Ms. Yelan gives me precisely this feeling. When she came to visit my family, my father and brother treated her with respect, and she was pleasant and polite in return. She seemed like a kind and mature young lady to me. But when I saw her elsewhere, she gave a completely different impression.

voices.title: About Gaming
voices.text: Gaming's work has all the trappings of a chivalric hero. Picture the scene — on a dark and moonless night, a lone young figure clad in black stands fearless on a secluded country road. They say his mastery of the martial arts is unparalleled, and the mythical beast by his side always does his bidding... Bandits and brigands beware, for none who challenge him come away unscathed... When he has the time, I'd love to hear more about his experiences as a guard. You should come along too.

voices.title: More About Xingqiu: I
voices.text: Are you keeping well, my liege? If you have no other matters to attend to, might I recommend a trip to the Wanwen Bookhouse?

voices.title: More About Xingqiu: II
voices.text: You ask why I enjoy reading in solitude? ...Studiousness can hardly be considered a bad habit. There's not much more to it than that. Really.

voices.title: More About Xingqiu: III
voices.text: Your schedule is free today? Wonderful. I am ready to leave whenever you are. ...My book? Oh, never mind that! I can always pick up where I left off when I get back. But those in distress who need our assistance cannot afford to wait.

voices.title: More About Xingqiu: IV
voices.text: You feel inspired, you say? You want to write a martial arts detective novel based on our adventures together? And you want to call it the "Chronicles of Wanwen"? Hahaha... It's a good idea, it really is. But I'll have to decline, I'm sorry. Yes, really...

voices.title: More About Xingqiu: V
voices.text: "A weaver of verses who draws from an ocean of expression..." That's the reputation I aspire to. But you're the only person I can share that with. I am actually writing a novel... but I can't let you see it. Not yet. The time will come, though... You'll be able to read it when it's on sale in book stores all over Liyue.

voices.title: Xingqiu's Hobbies
voices.text: Evidently, my hobby is reading. I'll read anything and everything. ...What's that mischievous grin for? Oh. That's between the two of us, okay? It's not appropriate to discuss it out loud. There's no point in bringing it up anyway.

voices.title: Xingqiu's Troubles
voices.text: What annoys me? Hmm... Well, one day my brother will inherit the family business. What will happen to me then? I fear my current carefree existence would... Oh — no no no, it's not about my status or anything like that. I don't care for that kind of thing. I just think my brother is something of a simpleton and I would probably end up having to do most of his job for him...

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: I like baked goods and Yue-style seafood. Probably because I'm used to quite a bland diet at home.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: I hate carrots. When I was young, my mother would mash them up into... Ugh, I can't go on. Just thinking about it makes me feel sick...

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: I need only sample this delight but once for its aroma to remain forever in my memory.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: With cooking skills as good as yours, it'd be a waste not to open a restaurant, wouldn't you agree?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: I couldn't possibly. But please, you eat your fill. I insist.

voices.title: Birthday: Wishing
voices.text: May this day of your birth be filled with much mirth!

voices.title: Birthday: Customs
voices.text: According to historical records, Tiancheng's stone bridge was formed by a fallen rock spear thrown by the Geo Archon Morax in battle. If you walk along the bridge on your birthday and throw some Mora into the sea from both sides, you will be blessed in the coming year... Your birthday only comes once a year, so be quick about it if you wanna go... I'm not kidding, it's true! Go try it and you'll see!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Were it not for my capability, the cause that so inspires me would remain confined to the pages that extol its virtues.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Had I no moral compass, my efforts would have been misguided. Doomed to grasp at shadows while missing the substance, I would have become a philistine that seeks only violence.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: There is a cause that I seek to champion, yet few in Liyue share my aspiration. This I have known for a long time, for it is a path I have walked for many years.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: I am most grateful for your company on my journey. I am proud of my achievements, both in the martial arts and in championing the cause so dear to my heart. ...Ah, I guess there's no need to euphemize any longer. Chivalry! That is the cause that inspires me, and that I seek to champion. Why should I shy away from it? I am sure my father and brother are under no illusion as to what I stand for by now. ...But of course, I still need to be somewhat discreet in the way I go about my business.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Rain outlines your fate!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Ha... Hmph!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Know my sword!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Witness the power of Guhua!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Let me weave you a verse.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Raincutter!

voices.title: Sprint Start: I
voices.text: Body and mind.

voices.title: Sprint Start: II
voices.text: Time to act.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Excellent.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Treasure-hunting... A valiant endeavor.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: I hope we find long-lost ancient literature.

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: Change of plans...

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: I can no longer hold back.

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: May my final stand be a monument to chivalry.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Come. I have devised a plan.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Tread carefully.

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: I have taught you... everything... I know...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: The brightest flames... burn fastest...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: I am outplayed...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: A minor setback.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: I let my guard down.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: Not good...

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: May knowledge guide you.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Chivalry will never die.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: For justice.
